name: Surskit
flavour_text: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

name: Masquerain
flavour_text: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Brute Bonnet
flavour_text: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

name: Slither Wing
flavour_text: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

name: Iron Moth
flavour_text: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Golduck
flavour_text: It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow- moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Buizel
flavour_text: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

name: Floatzel
flavour_text: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and help fishers carry what they caught.

name: Snom
flavour_text: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Frosmoth
flavour_text: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

name: Iron Hands
flavour_text: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Thorns
flavour_text: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

name: Espeon
flavour_text: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

name: Flittle
flavour_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Espathra
flavour_text: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

name: Greavard
flavour_text: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
flavour_text: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Scream Tail
flavour_text: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

name: Iron Valiant
flavour_text: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Iron Leaves
flavour_text: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

name: Iron Boulder
flavour_text: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Iron Crown
flavour_text: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

name: Nacli
flavour_text: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

name: Naclstack
flavour_text: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

name: Garganacl
flavour_text: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

name: Great Tusk
flavour_text: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

name: Sandy Shocks
flavour_text: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

name: Umbreon
flavour_text: When darkness falls, the rings on the body begin to glow, striking fear in the hearts of anyone nearby.

name: Sneasel
flavour_text: This is a smart and sneaky Pokémon. A pair may work together to steal eggs by having one lure the parents away.

name: Weavile
flavour_text: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

name: Pawniard
flavour_text: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
flavour_text: It’s accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Kingambit
flavour_text: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

name: Glimmet
flavour_text: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

name: Glimmora
flavour_text: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Iron Jugulis
flavour_text: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

name: Roaring Moon
flavour_text: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

name: Corviknight
flavour_text: Although its wings have partly turned to steel and become heavy as a result, this Pokémon flies through the skies with ease.

name: Cufant
flavour_text: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

name: Copperajah
flavour_text: Copperajah are prideful, cantankerous Pokémon. Specimens with vibrant green skin command the respect of others of their kind.

name: Iron Treads
flavour_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

name: Altaria
flavour_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Walking Wake
flavour_text: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

name: Gouging Fire
flavour_text: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

name: Raging Bolt
flavour_text: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou’s ancestor.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Girafarig
flavour_text: Girafarig’s tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.

name: Farigiraf
flavour_text: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

name: Dunsparce
flavour_text: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.

name: Dudunsparce
flavour_text: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Rufflet
flavour_text: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.

name: Braviary
flavour_text: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Rookidee
flavour_text: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee’s wings, it’ll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.

name: Corvisquire
flavour_text: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

name: Flamigo
flavour_text: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

name: Snom
flavour_text: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Flittle
flavour_text: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

name: Iron Boulder
flavour_text: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

name: Glimmora
flavour_text: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

name: Raging Bolt
flavour_text: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou’s ancestor.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Rellor
flavour_text: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Tadbulb
flavour_text: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

name: Rabsca
flavour_text: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

name: Diglett
flavour_text: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.

name: Dugtrio
flavour_text: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Klawf
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

name: Orthworm
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Altaria
flavour_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

name: Iron Valiant
flavour_text: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

name: Roaring Moon
